name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: An animated avatar for React and shadcn, with groups that spread apart on hover.

meta.details: Avatar and AvatarGroup on Base UI Avatar: images fade in from a 4px blur once loaded so initials never flash; overlapping stacks with a cut-out ring spread apart on hover; the overflow count rolls.

docs: Import Avatar and AvatarGroup from components/eased/avatar/avatar. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".
